name: Beta 1.2.0 (4)
body:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Beta builds are for testing purposes and may contain bugs, regressions, or unexpected issues.** If you prefer a reliable experience, we recommend staying on the **Stable** channel.

### Improvements & Fixes
- Keep the auto-play cover while a Usenet stream hands off to the player (@kernexshadow)
- Added a connection tuner for Usenet providers (@kernexshadow)
- Wait for provider slots while tuning connections (@kernexshadow)
- Sign-out tuning connections with QUIT before closing them (@kernexshadow)
- Implementation of the frosted glass sidepanel, with ON/OFF toggle featured in Settings-Layout (@Rasimsson)
- Fixed how much data provider tuning can use (@kernexshadow)
- Usenet settings: shorter menu name, grouped sources and phone setup shortcuts (@ram130)
- Fall back to the next source on VC-1 and tunneled decoder failures (@DavidVamaiotu)
- Continue folder trailers on the details page (@skoruppa)
- Keep Home visible while details fades in over a framed hero trailer (@skoruppa)
- Attach trailer subtitles on the first load (@unsuns06)
- Apply saved hero sources before the first catalog load (@WhiteGiso)
- Fixed stub cloudstream MainActivity to stop .cs3 lifecycle crash (@halibiram)
- Restored the episode being watched after process death (@skoruppa)
- Keep the playback position when switching source (@skoruppa)
- Mark wifi as optional (@tapframe)
- Integrate on-device playback with standalone Usenet engine (@haaihond)
- Full suport for Blu-ray BDAV/BDMV M2TS streams over HTTP and ISO with usenet motor. To be merged with (@kernexshadow)
- Restored ASS/SSA sizing and opt-in styling (@Laskco)
- Added subtitles by audio on Blu-ray clips (@kernexshadow)
- Keep the Skip Intro button rounded while it fades (@skoruppa)
- Embedded-subtitle sync finishes several times faster on TV hardware and keep a separate subtitle style for ASS/SSA (@DavidVamaiotu, @skoruppa)
- Smooth scrolling to the episodes and a cheaper trailer fade (@skoruppa)
- Create audiosyncstrings.xml for PortuguesePortugal (@affcosta7)
- Create stringsratings.xml for PortuguesePortugal (@affcosta7)
- Updated strings.xml and added audiosyncstrings.xml (@blueocean2308)
- Added French strings for audio sync and recent settings (@SK-Gits)
- Added a format badge for styled subtitles instead of the codec (@skoruppa)
- Embedded subtitles are found again on hosts that reject HTTP/1.1 (@DavidVamaiotu)
- Fixed focus skipping single folder and source actions in collection editor and gray Home collection covers on cold loads (@halibiram, @Hatem-Slman)
- Usenet hud stats (@ram130)
- Added the trailer video on details opened from More like this (@skoruppa)
- Added the launcher Continue Watching channel when Continue Watching changes (@skoruppa)
- Render ASS with Laskco's libass fork (nuvio-libass v0.0.14) (@skoruppa)
- Draw the details background once and clip the hero gradient (@skoruppa)
- Open audio picker with remote audio-track key (@kud)
- Hungarian (TV): add missing strings and align with NuvioMobile (@emgeje)
- Match ampersand filename variants (@ofers)
- Start Blu-ray clips with LPCM tracks and list their DTS-HD tracks (@kernexshadow)
- Search anime catalog ids by their IMDb id and numbering (@kernexshadow)
- Added Simkl rewatch support to the TV client (@Judzim)
- Updated Hebrew Strings to Beta 1.1.1 (@uHleaf)

### Localization
- Updated Portuguese (Brazil) and Portuguese translations (@kernexshadow, @affcosta7)
- Updated strings.xml and added usenet translations (@blueocean2308)
- Added missing Arabic translations (Plex, Silo and new strings) and removed unnecessary quotation marks (@ii-g)
- Added French translations (@SK-Gits)
- Updated Polish translations (@skoruppa)
- Translation improvements and adjustments for Slovak language (@mmsw91)
- Updated Hebrew translations (@uHleaf)

### Improvements & Fixes
- Fixed stub cloudstream MainActivity to stop .cs3 lifecycle crash (@halibiram)
- Restored the episode being watched after process death (@skoruppa)
- Keep the playback position when switching source (@skoruppa)

name: Beta 1.2.0 (3)
body:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Beta builds are for testing purposes and may contain bugs, regressions, or unexpected issues.** If you prefer a reliable experience, we recommend staying on the **Stable** channel.

### Improvements & Fixes
- Added Plex Media Server (@ysosrs123)
- Added Silo on its own API (@ysosrs123)
- Give hero descriptions more time before and after auto-scroll (@skoruppa)
- Mirror the Classic hero gradient in RTL layouts (@skoruppa)
- Keep focus in the open sidebar while Home is still loading (@skoruppa)
- Include ambient mode settings in profile settings sync (@skoruppa)
- Keep Jellyfin and Emby sign-ins separate per profile (@skoruppa)
- Added title and episode ratings (@tapframe)
- Stop resolving every subtitle language on each subtitle menu build, added the add-on's subtitle label in the subtitle list, and added audio-based subtitle sync fallback (@skoruppa, @DavidVamaiotu)
- Hide talk show guest appearances from filmography (@skoruppa)
- Expand posters with hero trailers and hide hero details during fullscreen trailers (@skoruppa)
- Added French strings for Plex and Silo servers (@SK-Gits)
- Added season posters in the season tabs (@skoruppa)
- Keep focus on a Continue Watching card that moves to the front after playback (@kernexshadow)
- Continue home trailers on the details page (@skoruppa)
- Fixed ExoPlayer back-buffer clamping and low-RAM DV7 runtime overrides (@halibiram)
- Added a hero trailer location that keeps posters collapsed (@skoruppa)
- Improved the profile editor's panel/avatar focus links RTL-aware (@Yosi-Brown)
- Added subtitles on trailers (@unsuns06)
- Retry once over HTTP/2 after a 403 for streams with proxyHeaders (@blueocean2308)
- Start with the handed-off trailer state to avoid a backdrop flash (@skoruppa)
- Pause the trailer while cast or network pages cover the details (@skoruppa)
- Added confirmation dialog before deleting a plugin repository (@halibiram)
- Improved image memory while browsing catalogs (@skoruppa)
- Added TvReorderList drag reordering, pinned collection parity, and collection editor focus fixes (@halibiram)
- Added Movies / Series filter to filmography (@marezezelj)
- Order same-day upcoming episodes by release time (@DAnaeto)

### Localization
- Translation improvements and adding missing stringhs and files for Portuguese - Portugal language (@affcosta7, @blueocean2308, @skoruppa, @unsuns06, @halibiram, @pablomuri, @DavidVamaiotu)
- Translation improvements and adjustments for Slovak language (@mmsw91)

name: Beta 1.2.0 (2)
body:

- Bump mpv-android-lib to 0.2.1 (@skoruppa)

### Localization

name: Beta 1.2.0 (1)
body:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Beta builds are for testing purposes and may contain bugs, regressions, or unexpected issues.** If you prefer a reliable experience, we recommend staying on the **Stable** channel.

### Improvements & Fixes
- Fixed stub cloudstream MainActivity to stop .cs3 lifecycle crash (@halibiram)
- Honor pinned audio capabilities for forced AC-3 transcoding (@halibiram)
- Pull watch state early on startup and after in-app navigation (@kernexshadow)
- Keep a series in Continue Watching while its next-up is rebuilt, stable Continue Watching metadata, refresh on release and fewer meta lookups, and choose what selecting a Continue Watching item opens (@kernexshadow, @skoruppa)
- Updated End Credits chapters for movie recommendation timing (@skoruppa)
- Translate latest es-419 playback and layout strings (@omavel)
- Decode DASH MIME query hints before detection (@retrocodes12)
- Store font, background and shadow settings (@tapframe)
- Render subtitle fonts, backgrounds and shadows, added font, background and shadow to the subtitle style rail, import subtitle fonts from a phone, added subtitle appearance editor with live preview, fixed subtitle color row focus and clipping, and fixed stale font flash when switching subtitle fonts (@tapframe)
- Match font upload page to the other phone pages (@tapframe)
- Restored the episode being watched after process death (@skoruppa)
- Updated the audio clock when mpv video time drops to 0 (@skoruppa)
- Added an SPS/PPS init segment to HLS streams that lack them (@skoruppa)
- Slow the hero description auto-scroll to a reading pace (@skoruppa)
- Added a check mark for saved lists in the list picker like on mobile (@ram130)
- Refreshed expired saved and tokenized links (@skoruppa)
- Chapters setting for both engines and a chapter title toggle (@skoruppa)
- Log Trakt token refresh failures and skip progress polling while signed out (@ram130)
- Fixed /search refresh on field focus (@oathzed)
- Return focus to last-used voice/text input from results (@oathzed)
- Fixed Library grid reflow when navigating to and from Detail (@oathzed)
- Stop polling thermal headroom when the device cannot report it (@ram130)
- Improved HDR10+ metadata OBUs from AV1 streams (@halibiram)
- Let poster menus mark YouTube and other add-on videos watched (@deejay189393)
- Hero description scroll and landscape backdrop setting in folders following home (@skoruppa)
- Keep the series title when a card moves on to the next episode (@skoruppa)
- Fixed fall back to the next matching source on failure (@skoruppa)
- Repaint letterbox bars above the libass overlay (@halibiram)
- Fill missing Indonesian strings (@shroomgaze)

### Localization
- Updated Lithuanian translations (@afda1)
- Changes to Dutch translation after 1.1 update (@scheperr)
- Updated Greek, Spanish, French, Hebrew, Japanese, Polish, Portuguese (Brazil), Portuguese, Turkish, and Vietnamese translations (@skoruppa, @SK-Gits, @blueocean2308)
